article.story: NORTH CHARLESTON, S.C. -- — Anthony Ruffolo’s 39 points led Charleston Southern over West Georgia 92-68 on Saturday. Ruffolo added five rebounds for the Buccaneers (2-2). Jacob Taylor scored 11 points while going 2 of 6 from the floor, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and 5 for 5 from the line, and added five rebounds. Nicholas Errica went 4 of 8 from the field (3 for 7 from 3-point range) to finish with 11 points. Justin Redmond led the Wolves (0-4) in scoring, finishing with 12 points, four assists and two steals. West Georgia also got 11 points and three steals from Juaquin Dixon. Chas Lewless also had eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
